question: Which district in Arunachal Pradesh saw the inauguration of a Khelo India multipurpose hall in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kamle**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **January 2025**, a state-of-the-art **Khelo India multipurpose hall** was officially inaugurated in the **Kamle** district of **Arunachal Pradesh**.
 
• The infrastructure was established at **Raga**, which is the administrative headquarters of the **Kamle** district, to promote indoor sports activities among the local youth.
 
• The construction of this facility was funded under the **Khelo India Scheme**, a flagship national program of the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**, Government of India.
 
• The hall is designed to accommodate various sports such as **badminton**, **table tennis**, and **wrestling**, providing a dedicated space for athletes to train regardless of weather conditions.
 
• The inauguration reflects the government's focus on the **North Eastern Region** to identify and nurture grassroots talent in sports through the creation of modern infrastructure in remote areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Kamle District**:
 
 
• **Kamle** was inaugurated as the **22nd district** of **Arunachal Pradesh** in **December 2017**.
 
• It was carved out of the existing **Lower Subansiri** and **Upper Subansiri** districts to improve administrative efficiency.
 
• The district is inhabited primarily by the **Nyishi** community and the **Galo** tribe.
 
 
 
• **Khelo India Scheme**:
 
 
• Launched in **2018**, the **Khelo India - National Programme for Development of Sports** aims to revive the sports culture in India at the grassroots level.
 
• It provides an annual financial assistance of **Rs. 5 lakh** per annum for **8 years** to talented players identified in priority sports disciplines.
 
• The scheme has several components, including **State Level Khelo India Centres** and **Sports Infrastructure Utilization**.
 
 
 
• **Sports in Arunachal Pradesh**:
 
 
• The state government has been proactive in branding **Arunachal Pradesh** as a sports hub, focusing on disciplines like **weightlifting**, **archery**, and **karate**.
 
• Major sports infrastructure include the **Sangay Lhaden Sports Academy** located in **Itanagar**, which is also a **Khelo India State Centre of Excellence (KISCE)**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Geographic Significance**: The establishment of such facilities in **Kamle** is significant due to its difficult mountainous terrain, where outdoor sports activities are often hindered by heavy rainfall and geographic barriers.
 
• **Talent Identification**: The **Khelo India** initiative in the **Northeast** has been instrumental in bringing athletes from the region into the national spotlight, contributing significantly to India's medal tally in international events.
 
• **Governance**: The project completion in **2025** aligns with the state's vision of **"Vision 2030"** for sports, aiming to provide high-quality training facilities in every district of **Arunachal Pradesh**.
